newsitem.title: THAILAND: Trading halt in Natural Park lifted.
newsitem.headline: Trading halt in Natural Park lifted.

text.p: The Thai stock exchange said on Friday it had lifted a trading halt in stocks of property developer Natural Park Plc after the firm clarified its position on its recent inability to repay interest on its bonds.

Natural Park had said in a filing to the exchange that it was unable to pay interest on some of its unsecured debentures due on May 20 due to side-effects from a slowing national economy and was holding talks with its financial advisers to find a solution to the problem.
